ngtcp2-client --no-quic-dump --no-http-dump --exit-on-all-streams-close h3wire 4433 "$H3WIRE/trailers" 2>"$OUT/log" && grep -A1 "trailers started" "$OUT/log" | grep -q "\[x-check: ok\]"

ngtcp2-client -q --exit-on-all-streams-close --download="$OUT" h3wire 4433 $(seq -f "$H3WIRE/bytes/1048576?n=%g" 16) && test "$(sha256sum "$OUT"/* | cut -d" " -f1 | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $1, $2}')" = "16 $SHA_1M"

ngtcp2-client -q --exit-on-all-streams-close --download="$OUT" h3wire 4433 "$H3WIRE/bytes/8388608" "$H3WIRE/goaway" && echo "$SHA_8M  $OUT/8388608" | sha256sum -c - && test "$(cat "$OUT/goaway")" = goaway
